mechanism.claim: When at least four liquid alt perpetuals complete a volatile eight-hour auction with their closing price beyond their own quote-volume-weighted completed value in one common direction, and the cross-sectional displacement strength enters its causal upper tail, the crypto market has broadly migrated value rather than produced one idiosyncratic spike. Follow the common accepted-value direction in BTC for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict majority sign of alt log(last close / quote-volume-weighted mean close)
mechanism.why_distinct: BTC close-VWAP candidates are single-asset mean-reversion rules. Cross-alt close-location uses each bar's high-low geometry; path efficiency uses endpoint displacement over path length; return-turnover concordance ranks returns and turnover separately. HVCAVAC uses six independent block-level quote-volume-weighted value anchors and requires directional cross-sectional continuation consensus; it uses no BTC return direction, flow, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour BTC realized variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset broad alt value-area migration onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact aligned coherent bars_binance one-minute rows [D-8h,D) per alt
features.value_anchor: sum(close*quote_asset_volume)/sum(quote_asset_volume), with finite positive denominator and anchor
features.value_displacement: log(last completed close/value_anchor), finite strict nonzero
features.consensus: at least four of six displacement signs in one direction and strictly more than the opposite direction
features.consensus_strength: median absolute value_displacement among alts in the majority direction
features.strength_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid positive-consensus decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: full rule true now and false at immediately prior exact source-valid decision; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after all completed source paths are available
clock.reservation: natural global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, block, value anchor, displacement, breadth, rank, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
